heading: ### Large bags are still doing their job
block_immediately_before_heading_now: A large bag is the luggage carrier. It says, “I carry what you need.” A mini bag sets the scene. It says, “This is the mood today.”
block_immediately_after_heading_now: Still, large bags have not disappeared. Vogue also showed many kinds of bags in that 2026 season.
